parameters.query: SELECT s.*, u.phone_number, u.full_name, u.cpf FROM conversational_sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.id=$1;

parameters.jsCode: const source=$json; const request=$('Build Order Payload').first().json; const orderId=source.id??source.order_id; const paymentLink=source.payment_link??source.payment_url; if(!orderId||!paymentLink) throw new Error('Backend não retornou order_id e payment_link'); return [{json:{...request,order_id:String(orderId),payment_link:String(paymentLink)}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE conversational_sessions SET current_state='EXPECTING_PAYMENT', state_payload=state_payload || $2::jsonb WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *;
